```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggh4x)
library(eulerr)

hvidb <- read_tsv("data/hvidb.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(Organism_Interactor_virus = as.character(Organism_Interactor_virus),
         Organism_Interactor_human = as.character(Organism_Interactor_human))

hvidb <- hvidb %>% mutate(Uniprot_virus = str_remove(Uniprot_virus, "-PRO_.*$"),
                          Uniprot_human = str_remove(Uniprot_human, "-PRO_.*$"))

intact <- read_tsv("data/intact.tsv") 

viruses <- read_tsv("data/virus_taxids.txt", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]

corona_proteins_all <- read_tsv("data/corona_uniprot.tsv") %>% filter(`Organism (ID)` == 2697049)
corona_proteins_swiss <- corona_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed == "reviewed")
corona_proteins_trembl <- corona_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed != "reviewed")
corona_ot <- read_tsv("data/covid_targets_uniprot.tsv", col_names = c("id"))


hhv_proteins_all <- read_tsv("data/hsv_uniprot.tsv") %>% filter(`Organism (ID)` == 10298)
hhv_proteins_swiss <- hhv_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed == "reviewed")
hhv_proteins_trembl <- hhv_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed != "reviewed")
hsv_ot <- read_tsv("data/hsv_targets_uniprot.tsv", col_names = c("id"))

hiv_proteins_all <- read_tsv("data/hiv_uniprot.tsv") %>% filter(`Organism (ID)` == 11676)
hiv_proteins_swiss <- hiv_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed == "reviewed")
hiv_proteins_trembl <- hiv_proteins_all %>% filter(Reviewed != "reviewed")
hiv_ot <- read_tsv("data/hiv_targets_uniprot.tsv", col_names = c("id"))

string_700 <- read_tsv("data/string_700.tsv", col_names = c("A", "B"))

string_700_proteins <- unique(append(unique(string_700$A), unique(string_700$B)))
```

# Intact

```{r}
hosts <- intact %>% mutate(
  organism_a = str_extract(`Taxid interactor A`, "^taxid:\\d+") %>% str_extract("\\d+"),
  organism_b = str_extract(`Taxid interactor B`, "^taxid:\\d+") %>% str_extract("\\d+"))

homo_intact <- hosts %>% 
  filter(xor(organism_a == "9606" , organism_b == "9606")) %>%
  mutate(virus_taxid = ifelse(organism_a == "9606", organism_b, organism_a),
         virus_protein = ifelse(organism_a == "9606", `ID(s) interactor B`, `#ID(s) interactor A`),
         human_protein = ifelse(organism_a == "9606", `#ID(s) interactor A`, `ID(s) interactor B`)) %>%
  filter(virus_taxid %in% viruses) %>%
  filter(str_starts(virus_protein, "uniprotkb:"), str_starts(human_protein, "uniprotkb:")) %>%
  mutate(virus_protein = str_remove(virus_protein, "^uniprotkb:"),
         human_protein = str_remove(human_protein, "^uniprotkb:"),
         virus_protein = str_remove(virus_protein, "-PRO_.*$"),
         human_protein = str_remove(human_protein, "-PRO_.*$"))

species <- append(hosts$organism_a, hosts$organism_b) 
species_counts <- tibble(species = species) %>% count(species) 

homo_intact %>% 
  group_by(virus_taxid) %>%
  summarise(taxon_id_frequency = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon_id_frequency)) + 
  geom_histogram(color = "gray", fill = "steelblue", bins = 18, alpha = 0.4) + 
  labs(x = "taxon id frequency", title = "Distribution of interactions with human per virus (IntAct)") + 
  geom_freqpoly(color = "black", binwidth=1, boundary = 0, linewidth = 1) + 
  theme_bw()

#ggsave("plots/virphi_dist_intact.png", dpi = 500)

species_counts %>% ggplot(aes(x = n)) + 
  geom_histogram(color = "gray", fill = "steelblue", bins = 20, alpha = 0.4) + 
  labs(x = "taxon id frequency", title = "Distribution of interactions with human per organism (IntAct)") + 
  geom_freqpoly(color = "black", binwidth=1, boundary = 0, linewidth = 1) + 
  theme_bw()
#ggsave("plots/phi_dist_intact.png", dpi = 500)

print(paste("number of taxon ids in IntAct:", nrow(species_counts), "(contains organisms like mouse, rat and guinea pig)"))

```

```{r}
homo_intact_unique <- homo_intact %>%
  mutate(
    miscore = as.numeric(
      str_extract(`Confidence value(s)`, "(?<=intact-miscore:)\\d+\\.\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(virus_taxid, human_protein, virus_protein) %>%
  slice_max(miscore, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() 

print(paste("Number of virus taxon ids in in IntAct:", homo_intact_unique %>% select(virus_taxid) %>% distinct() %>% nrow()))
print(paste("Total number of interactions between human and all viruses in IntAct:", nrow(homo_intact)))
print(paste("Total number of unique interactions between human and all viruses in IntAct:", nrow(homo_intact_unique)))

hsv_intact <- homo_intact_unique %>% filter(virus_taxid == "10298")
corona_intact <- homo_intact_unique %>% filter(virus_taxid == "2697049")
hiv_intact <- homo_intact_unique %>% filter(virus_taxid == "11676")

hsv_intact_seeds <- hsv_intact %>%
  distinct(virus_protein) %>%
  pull(virus_protein)

hsv_intact_interactors <- hsv_intact %>% distinct(human_protein) %>% pull(human_protein)

corona_intact_seeds <- corona_intact %>%
  distinct(virus_protein) %>%
  pull(virus_protein)

corona_intact_interactors <- corona_intact %>% distinct(human_protein) %>% pull(human_protein)

hiv_intact_seeds <- hiv_intact %>%
  distinct(virus_protein) %>%
  pull(virus_protein)

hiv_intact_interactors <- hiv_intact %>% distinct(human_protein) %>% pull(human_protein)
```

```{r}
corona_int_filter <- corona_intact %>% filter(str_detect(`Interaction type(s)`, "direct interaction"))
hsv_int_filter <- hsv_intact %>% filter(str_detect(`Interaction type(s)`, "direct interaction"))
hiv_int_filter <- hiv_intact %>% filter(str_detect(`Interaction type(s)`, "direct interaction"))

corona_exp_filter <- corona_intact %>% 
  filter(`Expansion method(s)` == "-") %>% 
  group_by(human_protein) %>% 
  slice_max(miscore, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(miscore, n = 100, with_ties = FALSE)
hsv_exp_filter <- hsv_intact %>% filter(`Expansion method(s)` == "-")
hiv_exp_filter <- hiv_intact %>% filter(`Expansion method(s)` == "-")

```

# Intact vs HVIDB

```{r}
summary_df_seeds <- tibble(
  database = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "HVIDB", "HVIDB"),
  virus    = c("HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2", "HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2"),
  count    = c(
    n_distinct(hsv_intact$virus_protein),
    n_distinct(corona_intact$virus_protein),
    n_distinct(hhv_hvidb$Uniprot_virus),
    n_distinct(corona_hvidb$Uniprot_virus)
  )
) %>% mutate(metric = "Viral Interactors")

summary_df_interactions <- tibble(
  database = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "HVIDB", "HVIDB"),
  virus    = c("HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2", "HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2"),
  count    = c(
    nrow(hsv_intact),
    nrow(corona_intact),
    nrow(hhv_hvidb),
    nrow(corona_hvidb)
  )
) %>% mutate(metric = "Interactions")

summary_df_interactors <- tibble(
  database = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "HVIDB", "HVIDB"),
  virus    = c("HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2", "HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2"),
  count    = c(
    n_distinct(hsv_intact$human_protein),
    n_distinct(corona_intact$human_protein),
    n_distinct(hhv_hvidb$Uniprot_human),
    n_distinct(corona_hvidb$Uniprot_human)
  )
) %>% mutate(metric = "Human Interactors")

df <- bind_rows(summary_df_seeds, summary_df_interactions, summary_df_interactors) %>%
  mutate(
    virus    = factor(virus, levels = c("HSV-1", "SARS-CoV-2")),
    database = factor(database, levels = c("IntAct", "HVIDB")),
    metric   = factor(metric, levels = c("Viral Interactors", "Interactions", "Human Interactors"))
  )

make_plot <- function(v, m) {
  ggplot(filter(df, virus == v, metric == m),
         aes(x = database, y = count, fill = database)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    labs(title = paste(v, "-", m), x = "Database", y = "Count") + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
  values = if (v == "HSV-1") {
    c("IntAct" = "#0C5697", "HVIDB" = "#68B2F3")
  } else {
    c("IntAct" = "#C60C12", "HVIDB" = "#F6656A")
  }
)
}

p_hhv_seed  <- make_plot("HSV-1",    "Viral Interactors")
p_cor_seed  <- make_plot("SARS-CoV-2", "Viral Interactors")
p_hhv_int   <- make_plot("HSV-1",    "Interactions")
p_cor_int   <- make_plot("SARS-CoV-2", "Interactions")
p_hhv_inter <- make_plot("HSV-1",    "Human Interactors")
p_cor_inter <- make_plot("SARS-CoV-2", "Human Interactors")

bar_plot <- (p_hhv_seed | p_cor_seed) /
(p_hhv_int  | p_cor_int)  /
(p_hhv_inter| p_cor_inter)

bar_plot_hori <- (p_hhv_seed | p_hhv_int | p_hhv_inter) / (p_cor_seed | p_cor_int | p_cor_inter)

ggsave("plots/bar_combi.jpeg", bar_plot, dpi = 2400, height = 5, width = 4)

ggsave("plots/bar_combi_hori.jpeg", bar_plot_hori, dpi = 2400, height = 4, width = 6)
```

```{r}
make_row <- function(v) {
  d <- df %>% filter(virus == v)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = database, y = count, fill = database)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +  
    geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
    labs(title = v, x = "Database", y = "Count") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values =
      if (v == "HSV-1") c("IntAct" = "#0C5697", "HVIDB" = "#68B2F3")
      else c("IntAct" = "#C60C12", "HVIDB" = "#F6656A")
    ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + 
    theme(legend.position = "None")
}

row_hsv  <- make_row("HSV-1")
row_sars <- make_row("SARS-CoV-2")

bar_plot_hori_new <- row_hsv / row_sars
ggsave("plots/bar_combi_new.jpeg", bar_plot_hori_new, dpi = 2400, height = 4, width = 6)
```


```{r}
make_set <- function(df, human_col, virus_col) {
  df %>%
    select(all_of(c(human_col, virus_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[human_col]]), !is.na(.data[[virus_col]])) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    transmute(key = paste(.data[[human_col]], .data[[virus_col]], sep = "||")) %>%
    pull(key) %>%
    unique()
}

hsv_intact_set <- make_set(hsv_intact, "human_protein", "virus_protein")
hhv_hvidb_set <- make_set(hhv_hvidb, "Uniprot_human", "Uniprot_virus")


corona_intact_set <- make_set(corona_intact, "human_protein", "virus_protein")
corona_hvidb_set <- make_set(corona_hvidb, "Uniprot_human", "Uniprot_virus")

```

```{r}
plot_venn <- function(set_list, low, high, outfile) {
  p <- ggVennDiagram(set_list, label = "count") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low, high = high) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +           # overrides ggVennDiagram's fixed-ratio coord
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .12)) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
  ggsave(outfile, plot = p, width = 5, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 500, bg = "white")
}

plot_venn(list(IntAct = hsv_intact_interactors, HVIDB = hhv_hvidb_interactors,
                "Open Targets" = hsv_ot$id, "String 700" = string_700_proteins),
          "lightblue", "steelblue", "plots/seed_size/hhv_inter_venn.png")

plot_venn(list(IntAct = corona_intact_interactors, HVIDB = corona_hvidb_interactors,
                "Open Targets" = corona_ot$id, "String 700" = string_700_proteins),
          "#FC5F64", "darkred", "plots/seed_size/corona_inter_venn.png")

plot_venn(list(IntAct = hiv_intact_interactors, HVIDB = hiv_hvidb_interactors,
                "Open Targets" = hiv_ot$id, "String 700" = string_700_proteins),
          "lightgreen", "darkgreen", "plots/seed_size/hiv_inter_venn.png")
```



```{r}
# INTACT corona

INTACT_corona_group_interactions <- homo_intact_unique %>% 
  filter(virus_taxid %in% corona_group) %>% 
  mutate(interaction = human_protein) %>%
  distinct(virus_taxid, interaction) 

INTACT_corona_group_interactions_wide <- INTACT_corona_group_interactions %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols      = interaction,
    names_from   = virus_taxid,
    values_from  = present,
    values_fill  = FALSE
  )

INTACT_set_cols_corona <- setdiff(names(INTACT_corona_group_interactions_wide), "interaction")

upset(INTACT_corona_group_interactions_wide, 
      intersect = INTACT_set_cols_corona,
      name = "virus_taxid",
      base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = intersection_size()
  )) 
ggsave("plots/upset_corona_intact.png", dpi = 500)

#HVIDB corona

HVIDB_corona_group_interactions <- hvidb %>% 
  filter(Organism_Interactor_virus %in% corona_group) %>% 
  mutate(interaction = Uniprot_human) %>%
  distinct(Organism_Interactor_virus, interaction) 

HVIDB_corona_group_interactions_wide <- HVIDB_corona_group_interactions %>%

    id_cols      = interaction,

  )
```

```{r}
get_cdf_intact <- function(intact_df, disease_name = "a disease"){
  q_cutoffs <- tibble(
  pct = c(0.5, 0.75, 0.95),
  cutoff = quantile(intact_df$miscore, pct, na.rm = TRUE),
  label = paste0(pct * 100, "th pct")
) %>%
  arrange(cutoff) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = seq(0.75, 0.45, length.out = n()))  # spread labels vertically
  
  sorted_scores <- sort(intact_df$miscore, decreasing = TRUE)
  top_n_cutoffs <- tibble(
    n = c(200, 150, 100, 50),
    cutoff = sorted_scores[c(200, 150, 100, 50)],
    label = paste0("top ", n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(cutoff) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = seq(0.99, 0.8, length.out = n()))
  
  cdf_plot <- intact_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = miscore)) + 
    stat_ecdf(aes(y = 1 - after_stat(y))) +
    geom_vline(data = q_cutoffs, aes(xintercept = cutoff), 
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_text(data = q_cutoffs, 
              aes(x = cutoff, y = y_pos, label = label),
              angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, color = "red", size = 3) +
    geom_vline(data = top_n_cutoffs, aes(xintercept = cutoff), 
               linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
    geom_text(data = top_n_cutoffs, 
              aes(x = cutoff, y = y_pos, label = label),
              angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, color = "blue", size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste("Complementary cumulative distribution of MI scores for", disease_name),
         y = "Fraction of interactions with MIscore ≥ x") + 
    theme_bw()
  
  return(cdf_plot)
}

get_cdf_intact(corona_intact, "SARS-CoV-2")
get_cdf_intact(hsv_intact, "HSV-1")
get_cdf_intact(hiv_intact, "HIV-1")
```

```{r}
get_organism_interactions <- function(intact, org_taxid) {
  interactions <- intact %>%
    filter(`Taxid interactor A` == `Taxid interactor B`, str_detect(`Taxid interactor A`, org_taxid)) %>%
    mutate(
      protein_a = `#ID(s) interactor A`,
      protein_b = `ID(s) interactor B`
    ) %>%
    filter(
      str_starts(protein_a, "uniprotkb:"),
      str_starts(protein_b, "uniprotkb:")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      protein_a = str_remove(protein_a, "^uniprotkb:"),
      protein_b = str_remove(protein_b, "^uniprotkb:"),
      protein_a = str_remove(protein_a, "-PRO_.*$"),
      protein_b = str_remove(protein_b, "-PRO_.*$")
    ) %>%
    select(protein_a, protein_b) %>%
    filter(protein_a != protein_b) %>%
    mutate(
      p1 = pmin(protein_a, protein_b),
      p2 = pmax(protein_a, protein_b)
    ) %>%
    distinct(p1, p2) %>%
    rename(protein_a = p1, protein_b = p2)

  interactions
}

taxids <- c("9606", "10298", "11676", "2697049")

org_org <- map_dfr(taxids, function(tid) {
  tibble(taxid = tid, count = nrow(get_organism_interactions(intact, tid)))
}) %>%
  mutate(virus_name = case_when(
    taxid == "10298" ~ "HSV-1",
    taxid == "11676" ~ "HIV-1",
    taxid == "9606" ~ "Human",
    .default = "SARS-CoV-2"
  ),
  virus_name = fct_relevel(virus_name, "Human", after = Inf))


org_org %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = virus_name, y = count, fill = virus_name)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SARS-CoV-2" = "#F6656A", "HSV-1" = "#31ABE8", "HIV-1" = "#00D100", "Human" = "magenta")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "None",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) + 
  labs(x = "Organism name",y = "Count")
```

```{r}
canonicalize_pairs <- function(df, col_a, col_b) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      p1 = pmin({{ col_a }}, {{ col_b }}),
      p2 = pmax({{ col_a }}, {{ col_b }}),
      pair_id = paste(p1, p2, sep = "-")
    )
}
```
